provenance.sourceRef: ADR-0001 P4 (rules-layers): storybook-guidelines moved out of rules/core

notes: Rules-only pack: it carries the Storybook rule that used to sit in rules/core (gated stack_requires: react). Detected from a storybook or @storybook/* dependency, not from React, so a React project without Storybook no longer receives it. Story review stays with review-frontend and review-frontend-conventions, which read this pack's rule.
